messages.subject: add ECDF to list of stats...
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone know if there's plans to add ecdf to the list of stats available in ggplot2? I think it'd be a good idea (without knowing anything about design concepts it may violate or new complexities it introduces). This way, ecdf plots (i.e. stat="ecdf," geom="step") can be drawn in conjunction with colour and group aesthetics, etc.

As it is, we have to do this, correct?

tst<-data.frame(x=c(rnorm(100,0,2),runif(100),rnorm(100,4,5)),y=rep(c("a","b","c"),each=100))

ggplot(tst,aes(x))+
geom_step(data=subset(tst,y=="a"),aes(x,ecdf(x)(x)),colour="blue")+
geom_step(data=subset(tst,y=="b"),aes(x,ecdf(x)(x)),colour="green")+
geom_step(data=subset(tst,y=="c"),aes(x,ecdf(x)(x)),colour="red")


Adam Loveland

which should happen at the end of this month.
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/blob/ggplot2-0.9.2-rc/R/stat-ecdf.r

-Winston
